# Onu

> Javaabu's React UI component library (`@javaabu/onu`): shadcn/ui (Radix) and Tailwind CSS v4, right-to-left and Dhivehi first, Thaana typing from a Latin keyboard, one-variable theming (`--onu-primary`), dark mode, density modes and WCAG 2.2 AA. Built for Laravel apps (Inertia or plain forms) and Next.js.

Version 0.1.0. Every page below is plain Markdown with a Props table and an Accessibility section. Read a component's page before using it, and use only the props it lists. Source: https://github.com/Javaabu/onu.

## Rules

### Before writing code

- Look up a component's page before using it: `node_modules/@javaabu/onu/docs/<group>/<name>.md`, `onu_get_doc` in the MCP server, or the site's `llms.txt`. Each page has a **Props** table and an **Accessibility** section. Use only the props listed there.
- Prefer an Onu component over writing your own or using a shadcn/ui primitive directly. `llms.txt` lists every component with one line on what it is for. Only reach for `@javaabu/onu/primitives` (the shadcn/ui parts Onu is built on) to compose something Onu doesn't have.
- Don't add other UI kits (MUI, Chakra, Ant Design, Headless UI, a separate shadcn/ui copy) next to Onu.

### Setup

- One CSS entry: `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "@javaabu/onu/tailwind.css";` and, for the font pack, `@import "@javaabu/onu/fonts.css";`, which needs `npm install @fontsource-variable/inter @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono @fontsource-variable/noto-sans-thaana` first.
- Wrap the app once in `<ThemeProvider><OnuProvider>…</OnuProvider></ThemeProvider>`. `OnuProvider` sets `lang`, `dir` and density on `<html>`, so portals follow.
- Dhivehi: `locale={dv}` with `import { dv } from "@javaabu/onu/locales/dv"`, or `locale="dv"` to load it on demand. English needs no `locale`.
- Inertia or Next.js: pass the router's `Link` as `linkComponent` on `OnuProvider`; Onu's links and `href` props then use it.

### Imports

- Components, hooks and helpers come from `@javaabu/onu`. Heavy features have their own entry: `@javaabu/onu/charts`, `/maps`, `/editor`, `/calendar`, `/media`, `/query-builder`, `/export`, `/thaana`, `/icons/iconify`, `/icons/fontawesome`. The docs page's first code block shows the import.
- Never import from `@javaabu/onu/dist/...` or `@javaabu/onu/src/...`.

### Forms (Laravel)

- Put every control inside `FormField` with the field's `name` (bracket notation is fine, `items[0][name]`). `FormField` wires the label, help, errors and ARIA. Don't hand-write `<label>`, error text or `aria-describedby`.
- Use `Form` with an `onSubmit` that returns the request promise (axios, fetch or Inertia). It shows Laravel 422 errors under the fields, focuses the first one and shows the error summary. With Inertia, pass `errors={form.errors}` and `processing={form.processing}`.
- Submit with `SubmitButton` (spinner, no double submit), not a plain `Button type="submit"`.
- Pick the specific input: `EmailInput`, `PasswordInput`, `PhoneInput`, `NumberInput`, `DatePicker`, `ApiSelect` (Laravel paginated API), `InstantFileUpload`, and so on, rather than `TextInput type="…"`.
- Edit pages get `SaveBar`; index pages get `ListingPage` (or `DataTable` with `useListingState`).

### Dhivehi, Thaana and RTL

- Free-text fields that may hold Dhivehi take `thaana` (`<TextInput thaana />`, `<Textarea thaana />`), or use `ThaanaInput`. Never add `thaana` to email, password, URL, number, phone, OTP or code inputs; they stay LTR by design.
- Use logical Tailwind utilities only: `ms-*`/`me-*`, `ps-*`/`pe-*`, `start-*`/`end-*`, `text-start`/`text-end`, `border-s`/`border-e`, `rounded-s-*`/`rounded-e-*`. Never `ml-*`, `mr-*`, `pl-*`, `pr-*`, `left-*`, `right-*`, `text-left` or `text-right`. Flip transforms with `rtl:`.
- Sides are `side="start" | "end"`, not left/right.
- Format dates, numbers and money with `useFormatDate`, `useFormatNumber` and `useFormatCurrency` (MVR), not `toLocaleString` or hand-built strings. Numbers use Western digits in Dhivehi too.
- Built-in strings come from the locale. For your own strings use `useTranslation()` or your app's i18n, and override Onu's strings with `OnuProvider messages`.

### Styling and theming

- Brand colour: set `--onu-primary` (one variable re-themes everything). Use the theme tokens (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`, `bg-card`, …), never fixed colours like `bg-blue-600` or hex values, so dark mode and themes keep working.
- Restyle with `className` (merged with tailwind-merge, yours wins) and `classNames={{ part: "…" }}` for parts. Reuse exported variants such as `buttonVariants`. Use `asChild` to render your own element. No `!important`, no inline styles for static values.
- Density (`compact` to `touch`) and dark mode come from the providers; don't hard-code heights or `dark:` colours on Onu components.

### Icons

- Use `<Icon name="search" />` and `startIcon="add"` / `endIcon="…"` props with semantic names, not imports from `lucide-react`. Give icons that carry meaning a `label`; icon-only buttons need an accessible name (`aria-label` or the component's `label` prop).
- Directional icons mirror in RTL on their own; don't flip them yourself.

### Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)

- Onu components already handle roles, focus and keyboard. Don't remove focus rings, add `tabIndex` to non-interactive elements, or replace buttons with clickable `div`s.
- Announce async results with `toast()`, `announce()` or `LiveRegion`; hide text visually with `VisuallyHidden`, not `display: none`.
- Confirm destructive actions with `confirm()` / `useConfirm()` or the item's `confirm` option, not `window.confirm`.

### Bundle size

- Import only what you use; every entry is tree-shaken. Keep charts, maps, the editor, the calendar and media in their own entries (and lazy routes when they are big).

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/intro.md): Onu is Javaabu's React UI component library.
- [Installation & Setup](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/installation-and-setup.md): First install the NPM package

## Guides

Theming, RTL, Dhivehi, Thaana input, icons, fonts and more.

- [Design & density](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/design-and-density.md): Onu's default look pairs a Proton Mail-style app shell with Ant Design 5 content elements: 14px text, 32px controls, 6px control corners and 8px cards, hairline borders, plain greys, and colour used for emphasis.
- [Theming](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/theming.md): Onu's default theme pairs a Proton Mail-style app shell with Ant Design 5 content elements
- [Dark mode](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/dark-mode.md): Every Onu component has a dark variant. Dark mode turns on when an ancestor has the `dark` class or `data-theme="dark"`, so it works with any toggling approach.
- [RTL](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/rtl.md): Every Onu component works right-to-left with no extra props.
- [Dhivehi & locales](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/dhivehi-and-locales.md): Onu ships with English (`en`) and Dhivehi (`dv`).
- [Thaana input](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/thaana-input.md): Onu can type Thaana from a Latin keyboard, so users don't need a Dhivehi keyboard installed.
- [Icons](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/icons.md): Onu uses Lucide icons by default, with no setup.
- [Fonts](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/fonts.md): Onu's optional font pack. Install the three Latin and fallback fonts it loads from npm, then import it after `tailwind.css`
- [Accessibility](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/accessibility.md): Onu targets WCAG 2.2 Level AA for every component, in light and dark mode and in both directions.
- [Style overrides](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/style-overrides.md): Every component can be restyled without forking it.
- [Forms & Laravel validation](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/forms-and-laravel.md): Onu's form components are built around Laravel's conventions, so server validation errors show up under the right fields with no glue code.
- [Inertia & Next.js](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/inertia-and-nextjs.md): Onu is plain React, so it works in Vite apps, Laravel + Inertia (React) and Next.js.
- [AI assistants](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/ai-assistants.md): Onu's docs are written so AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT and others) can use them: every page is plain Markdown with a Props table and an Accessibility section, and there is a short list o…
- [Rules for AI assistants](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/guides/rules-for-ai.md): Short rules for AI coding assistants (and people) writing UI with Onu.

## Accessibility

Screen-reader helpers: visually hidden text, live regions and announcements.

- [VisuallyHidden](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/accessibility/visually-hidden.md): Content for screen readers only. It is taken out of the visual layout with Tailwind's `sr-only` but is still read out, and focusable content inside it stays in the tab order.
- [LiveRegion](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/accessibility/live-region.md): An `aria-live` region: screen readers read its text whenever it changes, without moving focus.
- [useAnnouncer and announce](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/accessibility/use-announcer.md): Announces messages to screen-reader users: "Row moved to position 3", "Settings saved", "4 results".

## Form scaffolding

Forms, fields, labels, errors and buttons.

- [Form](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/form.md): A `<form>` that handles the boring parts: label layout for every field, disabling fields while saving, server validation errors (Laravel 422) under each field, an error summary at the top, and moving focus to the firs…
- [FormField](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/form-field.md): A label, a control, help text and error messages, laid out stacked (label above) or inline (label beside).
- [Form layout & errors](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/form-context.md): Providers that configure every `FormField` inside them.
- [FormGroup](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/form-group.md): Lays out related fields in a responsive grid and sets their label layout.
- [Fieldset / FormSection](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/fieldset.md): A titled section of a form: a real `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>`, an optional description, and an optional collapse toggle.
- [Label](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/label.md): shadcn's `Label` with a required marker or an "(optional)" note.
- [RequiredMarker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/required-marker.md): The `*` shown after a required field's label.
- [FieldErrors](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/field-errors.md): Error messages for one field, each with an error icon.
- [ValidationSummary (AJAX validation errors)](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/validation-summary.md): An error summary for the top of a form. It lists every error, and each one is a link that moves focus to its field.
- [HelpText](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/help-text.md): Supporting text under a control. `FormField` renders it from the `help` prop and links it with `aria-describedby`.
- [FormContainer](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/form-container.md): A card-style layout for a form: a header (title, description, actions), the body and a footer for the buttons.
- [RepeatingGroup](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/repeating-group.md): A list of repeated rows of fields (line items, family members, contact numbers) with Add, Remove and Move up / Move down.
- [InlineEdit](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/inline-edit.md): Text that turns into an input when clicked, for quick edits on detail pages and tables.
- [AutosaveIndicator](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/autosave-indicator.md): Shows whether changes are being saved automatically: idle, saving, saved (with relative time, "Saved 2 minutes ago") or error (with Retry).
- [SaveBar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/save-bar.md): The save bar for edit pages (REQUIREMENTS §25.9).
- [useUnsavedChangesGuard](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/unsaved-changes-guard.md): Warns before leaving a page with unsaved changes (§25.9).
- [FloatingSubmit](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/floating-submit.md): A submit button that floats at the bottom of the screen while the form's main submit button is scrolled out of view, so a long form can be submitted from anywhere.
- [SubmitButton](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/submit-button.md): A `type="submit"` `Button` that shows a spinner while the form is processing and ignores clicks until it finishes, so a form can't be submitted twice.
- [Button](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/button.md): Onu's button: shadcn's `Button` with a `loading` state, `startIcon` / `endIcon`, and extra `success` and `warning` variants.
- [LinkButton](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/link-button.md): A link that looks like a `Button`. It renders through the `linkComponent` set on `OnuProvider`, so it navigates with Inertia, Next.js or your router (R16.2).
- [ButtonGroup](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/button-group.md): Groups related buttons. By default the buttons are joined into one segmented control (shadcn's button group); `attached={false}` keeps them separate with a gap and lets them wrap.
- [Auth forms](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/auth-forms.md): Ready-made, presentational authentication forms: `SignInForm`, `RegisterForm`, `ForgotPasswordForm` and `ResetPasswordForm`.
- [eFaas button](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/efaas-button.md): The Sign in with eFaas button, styled after the eFaas brand guide (R16.7).
- [eFaas logo](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/form-scaffolding/efaas-logo.md): The 22 official eFaas logos from eFaas's brand kit, unchanged, as one component.

## Text inputs

Text, Thaana, number, phone, OTP and other inputs.

- [TextInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/text-input.md): A single-line text input with optional addons and Thaana keyboard support.
- [EmailInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/email-input.md): An email address input. It sets `type="email"`, `inputMode="email"` (the email keyboard on phones) and `autocomplete="email"`, turns off auto-capitalisation and spell check, and is always left-to-right, even on a Dhiv…
- [PasswordInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/password-input.md): A password input with a show/hide button, a Caps Lock warning and an optional strength meter.
- [SensitiveInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/sensitive-input.md): A read-only display for a secret such as an API key or client secret.
- [CopyInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/copy-input.md): A read-only value with a copy button: share links, reference numbers, account numbers.
- [NumberInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/number-input.md): A numeric input with locale-aware formatting, `min` / `max` / `step`, and spinbutton keys.
- [QuantityStepper](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/quantity-stepper.md): A number with large − and + buttons, for cart quantities, tickets and guest counts.
- [UnitInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/unit-input.md): A number with a unit add-on: either fixed text (`kg`, `MVR`, `%`) or a unit select (`m` / `km`).
- [PhoneInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/phone-input.md): An international phone number input built on `react-phone-number-input` (libphonenumber).
- [UrlInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/url-input.md): A URL input. It sets `type="url"`, `inputMode="url"` and `autocomplete="url"`, is always left-to-right, and adds `https://` when the user leaves the field without a scheme (`javaabu.com` → `https://javaabu.com`).
- [HiddenInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/hidden-input.md): A hidden form value. Inside a `FormField` it takes the field's `id` and `name`, so server errors for that name show on the field like any other control.
- [Textarea](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/textarea.md): A multi-line text input that grows with its content, with Thaana support and an optional character counter.
- [ThaanaInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/thaana-input.md): `ThaanaInput` and `ThaanaTextarea` are `TextInput` and `Textarea` with Thaana typing on and the Thaana/Latin toggle shown by default.
- [ThaanaToggle](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/thaana-toggle.md): The button that switches a field between Thaana and Latin typing.
- [OtpInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/otp-input.md): A one-time code input built on shadcn's `input-otp`.
- [SlugInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/slug-input.md): A slug generator, like `slugInput` in `@javaabu/js-utilities`.
- [Autocomplete](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/autocomplete.md): A free-text input with suggestions. The typed text is the value; suggestions only help fill it in (for a fixed list of choices, use a select).
- [ColorPicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/color-picker.md): A colour picker built on React Aria's colour components.
- [IconPicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/icon-picker.md): An icon picker with search and a virtualised grid (TanStack Virtual), so thousands of icons stay fast.
- [SignaturePad](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/signature-pad.md): A signature pad built on `signature_pad`.
- [TagsInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/tags-input.md): A chips input for keywords, topics and similar lists.
- [QrCodeScanner](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/text-inputs/qr-code-scanner.md): A QR code scanner. It opens the camera with `getUserMedia`, decodes frames with the browser's `BarcodeDetector`, and loads the `barcode-detector` polyfill (ZXing in WebAssembly) only where the native API is missing (R…

## Date and time

Date, time and range pickers and calendars.

- [DatePicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/date-picker.md): A date field that opens a calendar. Built on shadcn's `Calendar` (react-day-picker) inside a `Popover`, or a bottom-sheet `Drawer` on phones (R3.28).
- [TimePicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/time-picker.md): A time field that opens large hour and minute steppers with ▲/▼, an AM/PM switch, a clock-face hour grid and a minute grid (REQUIREMENTS §25.2).
- [DateTimePicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/date-time-picker.md): A calendar with a time chip underneath (REQUIREMENTS §25.3).
- [DateRangePicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/date-range-picker.md): Two fields side by side, From and To, each opening a DatePicker (or a DateTimePicker with `withTime`).
- [MonthPicker and YearPicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/month-picker.md): Pick a month (or a year) from a grid of 12 that zooms out to years and ranges of years.
- [HijriDate](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/hijri-date.md): Shows a date in the Umm al-Qura Hijri calendar, e.g.
- [HijriDatePicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/hijri-date-picker.md): Picks a date on the Umm al-Qura Hijri calendar.
- [MultipleDatePicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/multiple-date-picker.md): Picks any number of days from one calendar.
- [WeekPicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/week-picker.md): Picks a whole week: clicking any day selects its week, hovering previews the week, and week numbers are shown.
- [ReportingPeriodPicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/reporting-period-picker.md): Picks a monthly, quarterly, yearly or custom reporting period, with a configurable financial-year start.
- [DateCalendar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/date-calendar.md): The calendar inside every Onu date picker, for use inline.
- [TimePanel](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/time-panel.md): The steppers, clock-face hour grid and minute grid used inside TimePicker and DateTimePicker, for use inline (e.g.
- [FullCalendar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/date-and-time/full-calendar.md): A full calendar with month, week, day and agenda views, built on FullCalendar v6 using only its MIT "standard" plugins (`daygrid`, `timegrid`, `list`, `interaction`; R4.3).

## Choice inputs

Selects, checkboxes, radios, switches and pickers.

- [Select](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/select.md): A select for short lists, built on shadcn's select (Radix).
- [Searchable select](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/searchable-select.md): A select with a search field: a field that opens a searchable list (shadcn Popover + Command; a bottom sheet on phones).
- [Dependent select](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/dependent-select.md): A select whose options depend on another field (atoll → island).
- [API select](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/api-select.md): A searchable select that loads its options from any API (REQUIREMENTS R16.5).
- [Editable select](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/editable-select.md): A text field with a list of suggestions that also accepts anything the user types (a WAI-ARIA combobox with list autocomplete).
- [Multi-select](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/multi-select.md): Pick several options. Selected values show as chips in the field (each with a remove button), the list has a "Select all" row for the visible options, and `max` caps the number of values.
- [Dual listbox](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/dual-listbox.md): Two lists, "Available" and "Selected", with buttons to move items between them.
- [Checkbox](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/checkbox.md): shadcn's checkbox plus a label, description and an indeterminate (mixed) state.
- [Radio](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/radio.md): One radio button with a label, description and, in the card variant, media and an aside.
- [Radio group](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/radio-group.md): A set of radios where one can be chosen (shadcn radio group).
- [Switch](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/switch.md): shadcn's switch plus a label and description.
- [Segmented control](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/segmented-control.md): Pick one of a few options shown side by side (shadcn toggle group, single mode).
- [Range slider](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/range-slider.md): A slider for one value or a range (shadcn slider), with marks, value labels and locale number formatting.
- [Rating](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/rating.md): A star rating with optional half steps, a read-only display mode and full keyboard support.
- [Payment method selector](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/payment-method-selector.md): Choose how to pay: BML Transfer (bank transfer to a Bank of Maldives account, usually followed by a slip upload) and/or BML Connect (BML's online card gateway), as a radio group of large cards with BML's official logo…
- [BML logos](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/bml-logos.md): Bank of Maldives' official logos, supplied by BML, as React components (R16.8).
- [Account switcher](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/account-switcher.md): Switch between your own account and accounts you act for: organisations and delegated individuals (e.g.
- [Image select](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/image-select.md): A grid of image options: one choice (radio semantics) or several (`multiple`, checkbox semantics).
- [Select with quick-create](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/choice-inputs/quick-create-select.md): A searchable select that can create the option the user is looking for.

## Files and media

Uploads, images, galleries and media.

- [FileInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/file-input.md): A styled native file input. The real `<input type="file">` covers the trigger, so clicking, tapping, the keyboard (Enter/Space) and dropping a file onto it all work natively.
- [MultipleFileInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/multiple-file-input.md): A `FileInput` for several files: each pick adds to the list (duplicates are skipped), every file has a remove button, and an optional hint shows the limits with a live count ("3 of 5").
- [InstantFileUpload](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/instant-file-upload.md): Uploads each file as soon as it is chosen, with a progress bar per file, cancel, retry and remove.
- [UploadProgress](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/upload-progress.md): A list of uploads, each with its name, size, progress bar, status (waiting, uploading, uploaded, failed, cancelled) and cancel / retry / remove buttons.
- [DropzoneUploader](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/dropzone-uploader.md): A drag-and-drop zone built on `react-dropzone`, with a "Browse files" button as the keyboard and touch alternative, paste from the clipboard, validation messages, and an upload progress list when given an uploader.
- [AdditionalFilesUpload](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/additional-files-upload.md): Manages a record's attachments on an edit page: existing files can be removed (and restored before saving), and new files can be added, each with an optional display name and description.
- [ImageInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/image-input.md): Picks one image with a preview, and Replace / Remove buttons.
- [AvatarUpload](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/avatar-upload.md): A circular avatar picker: shows the photo (or initials), opens a crop step after picking (using `ImageCropper`), and offers Change and Remove.
- [ImageCropper](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/image-cropper.md): Crops an image with `react-easy-crop`: drag or pinch to move and zoom, arrow keys to nudge, a zoom slider, rotation, aspect-ratio presets, and Blob/File output.
- [MediaLister](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/media-lister.md): A media library: grid or list view, search, single or multiple selection, type icons and lazy thumbnails, with infinite or paged loading driven by props (fetch the data however you like).
- [Gallery](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/gallery.md): A responsive image grid or masonry layout.
- [Lightbox](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/lightbox.md): A full-screen image viewer built on yet-another-react-lightbox: keyboard, swipe, pinch/double-tap/wheel zoom, captions and a counter, with a focus trap, focus return, translated labels and mirrored arrows in RTL.
- [Carousel](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/carousel.md): shadcn's Carousel (Embla) extended with RTL direction, translated controls, dot navigation, autoplay with a pause button, and slide announcements.
- [AttachmentPreview](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/attachment-preview.md): A file attachment: thumbnail or type icon, name, type and size, with open, download and remove actions.
- [DocumentDownload](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/document-download.md): A downloadable document card with its type, size and a download link, optionally in several language versions (English and Dhivehi).
- [MediaPlayer](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/media-player.md): An accessible audio and video player built on Media Chrome: play/pause, seek, time, mute and volume, captions, playback speed and full screen, with keyboard shortcuts, translated labels and Onu theming.
- [VideoEmbed](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/video-embed.md): A click-to-load YouTube or Vimeo embed (the "lite embed" pattern): it shows a thumbnail and a play button, and loads the privacy-enhanced player (`youtube-nocookie.com`, Vimeo with `dnt=1`) only when the user presses…
- [FileIcon](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/file-icon.md): A coloured icon for a file's type (image, video, audio, PDF, document, spreadsheet, presentation, archive, text), detected from the MIME type or the file extension.
- [QrCode](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/files-and-media/qr-code.md): A QR code generator. The text is encoded with `uqr` (MIT, zero dependencies) and Onu renders the SVG itself, so the dark modules use `currentColor` and follow theme tokens.

## Rich content

Editors and renderers.

- [WYSIWYG editor](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/rich-content/wysiwyg-editor.md): A rich text editor built on Tiptap (ProseMirror).
- [Block editor](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/rich-content/block-editor.md): A block-based editor (page builder) on Tiptap.
- [Block renderer](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/rich-content/block-renderer.md): Renders block editor (or WYSIWYG) JSON to React without loading the editor.
- [Code block](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/rich-content/code-block.md): Read-only code with Shiki syntax highlighting, a language label, a copy button and optional line numbers.
- [Translations editor](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/rich-content/translations-editor.md): Edit translation keys side by side in English and Dhivehi (or any languages).
- [Custom attribute fields](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/rich-content/custom-attribute-fields.md): Renders form fields from a schema, for custom attributes, settings or product specs, using Onu's inputs.
- [ThaanaKeyboard (Tiptap)](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/rich-content/thaana-keyboard.md): A Tiptap extension that types Thaana from a Latin keyboard through ProseMirror transactions rather than DOM edits (R13.2), so undo/redo, input rules and collaboration keep working.

## Maps

Google Maps components.

- [MapProvider](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-provider.md): Configures the map engine for every map inside it.
- [MapView](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-view.md): The base map. Put markers, shapes and layers inside it.
- [MapPicker](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-picker.md): Pick a point: click the map, drag the pin, search a place, use the device location, or type the latitude and longitude.
- [MapRadius](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-radius.md): A centre and a radius in metres: click to place the centre, drag the handles, or type the numbers.
- [MapPolygon](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-polygon.md): Draw and edit polygons (zones, plots, service areas).
- [MapRoute](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-route.md): Draw a route as a line (patrol path, ferry line, delivery route).
- [LiveMap](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/live-map.md): Markers that move as positions arrive, from props (polling) or a stream (WebSocket, SSE, Laravel Echo).
- [MapNavigation](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-navigation.md): Turn-by-turn style directions between stops: the route on the map, a summary, and a step list with Previous / Next.
- [LocationCard](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/location-card.md): A place at a glance: a static map thumbnail, the address, coordinates and an Open in Google Maps link.
- [AddressInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/address-input.md): Structured Maldivian address fields: atoll, island, road and house/building name, with an optional map pin.
- [MapReplay](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-replay.md): Plays back a timestamped track (a vessel trip, a delivery run): play/pause, speed and a scrubber.
- [MapInfoPanel](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-info-panel.md): Details of the selected marker: a side panel over the map on desktop and a bottom sheet on phones.
- [RouteStopEditor](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/route-stop-editor.md): An ordered list of stops synced with numbered markers.
- [HeatmapLayer](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/heatmap-layer.md): A density heatmap inside a `MapView`. On Google Maps it is deck.gl's `HeatmapLayer` through `GoogleMapsOverlay` (Google's own HeatmapLayer is deprecated and never used).
- [ViewportMarkerMap](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/viewport-marker-map.md): Loads markers for the visible area through your fetcher and clusters them (`@googlemaps/markerclusterer`).
- [MapLegendSwatch](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/maps/map-legend-swatch.md): Colour and shape samples that match how layers are drawn, and `MapLegend`, a labelled list of them.

## Charts

Charts and statistics.

- [BarChart](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/charts/bar-chart.md): A bar graph built on shadcn's chart (`ChartContainer` + Recharts).
- [LineChart](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/charts/line-chart.md): A line graph on shadcn's chart (Recharts).
- [PieChart](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/charts/pie-chart.md): A pie or donut chart on shadcn's chart (Recharts).
- [TimeSeriesChart](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/charts/time-series-chart.md): A line, area or bar chart on a real time axis, optionally stacked.
- [PeriodComparisonChart](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/charts/period-comparison-chart.md): Compares the current period with the previous one: headline totals with a delta percentage and an up/down indicator, the two periods overlaid (previous dashed, or as muted bars), and a table with the change per step.
- [Sparkline](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/charts/sparkline.md): A tiny inline line or area chart with no axes, labels or tooltip, for trends in tables, stat tiles and text.
- [StatTile](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/charts/stat-tile.md): KPI tiles: a label, a formatted value, a delta (arrow + sign + semantic colour), an optional icon and sparkline, and a loading skeleton.
- [DeltaIndicator](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/charts/delta-indicator.md): A change indicator: an arrow icon, a signed percentage and a semantic colour.
- [MapChart](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/charts/map-chart.md): A choropleth map: regions shaded by value on Google Maps, drawn with a deck.gl `GeoJsonLayer` (`GoogleMapsOverlay`).

## Listing pages

Tables, filters, pagination and listing tools.

- [ListingPage](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/listing-page.md): A complete index page, laid out as REQUIREMENTS §25.6 describes: a header with the title, the main action and secondary links (Trash, with a dot when it isn't empty), status tabs, a toolbar with the search box, Filter…
- [useListingState](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/use-listing-state.md): State for an index page — search, sort, page, rows per page, filters, view, selection and column visibility — with the rules from REQUIREMENTS §25.6 built in
- [DataTable](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/data-table.md): The listing table, built on TanStack Table v9 (column model, visibility and selection) and shadcn's `Table`.
- [FilterPanel](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/filter-panel.md): The Filters button and its panel (REQUIREMENTS §25.7): a dropdown on desktop and a bottom sheet on phones.
- [ActiveFilterChips](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/active-filter-chips.md): One pill per applied filter under the toolbar (REQUIREMENTS §25.7): "Status: Active", "Created: 1 Mar → 31 Mar", "Created: from 1 Mar".
- [SearchBox](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/search-box.md): The search box of an index page. Typing does nothing until the user presses Enter or leaves the box after changing the text (REQUIREMENTS §25.6), so a request isn't sent for every keystroke.
- [Pagination](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/pagination.md): Pagination for listings, laid out like Ant Design's: "Showing 26–50 of 312 users" at the start, then numbered pages between the previous and next arrows, then a rows-per-page select (10 / 25 / 50 / 100).
- [PerPage](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/per-page.md): A rows-per-page select (shadcn `Select`), used by `Pagination`.
- [BulkActionBar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/bulk-actions.md): The bulk action bar (REQUIREMENTS §25.6).
- [RowActions](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/row-actions.md): The ⋯ menu at the end of a row (REQUIREMENTS §25.6), on shadcn's `DropdownMenu`.
- [RecordActionsMenu](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/record-actions-menu.md): Actions in a record page header (e.g. Logs, Approve, Delete — REQUIREMENTS §25.8).
- [EmptyState](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/empty-state.md): Empty states for listings (REQUIREMENTS §25.6), on shadcn's `Empty`
- [ViewSwitcher](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/view-switcher.md): Switches a listing between table, list, grid and board views.
- [ColumnVisibility](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/column-visibility.md): A "Columns" menu with a checkbox per column, to show or hide table columns.
- [FilterTabs](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/filter-tabs.md): Status tabs above a listing, with counts: "All 312 · Active 280 · Banned 32".
- [ExportMenu](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/export-menu.md): An Export button with a menu of formats (CSV, Excel, PDF).
- [exportRows (client-side export)](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/export-rows.md): Builds a CSV, Excel or PDF file in the browser from the rows you already have, for apps without a server export.
- [FilterSubmit](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/filter-submit.md): Submit and Reset buttons for a classic filter form, e.g.
- [ListView](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/list-view.md): Records as a vertical list: media (avatar, icon), title, description and details, with optional checkboxes and a ⋯ menu per item.
- [GridView](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/grid-view.md): Records as a responsive grid of cards. Columns follow the space available (`repeat(auto-fill, minmax(…))`), not the viewport, so the grid also works in a sidebar or a narrow column.
- [KanbanBoard](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/kanban-board.md): A board of columns with cards that move between them, on `@dnd-kit/react`.
- [TreeView](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/tree-view.md): A tree of records (folders, categories, atolls and islands, org units) on React Aria's `Tree`, which implements the WAI-ARIA tree grid pattern.
- [SortableList](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/sortable-list.md): A list the user can put in order (menu items, steps, priorities), on `@dnd-kit/react`: drag the handle with a mouse or by touch (press and hold), use the keyboard on the handle, or use the Move up / Move down buttons.
- [ReorderableTable](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/reorderable-table.md): Drag-and-drop row reordering for tables (route stops, menu items, priorities), on `@dnd-kit/react` and shadcn's `Table`.
- [EditableDataGrid](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/editable-data-grid.md): A spreadsheet-like table for quick edits (order lines, stock counts, rates), following the WAI-ARIA grid pattern.
- [SearchResults](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/search-results.md): Search results grouped by type (Services, News, Pages), with a count per group and the search words highlighted.
- [LoadMore](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/load-more.md): A Load more button for lists and grids, with "Showing 1–20 of 312" and an announcement of how many items arrived.
- [FilterConditionBuilder](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/listing-pages/filter-condition-builder.md): Advanced filters as conditions — "Status is Active and Island is one of Malé, Hulhumalé" — on `react-querybuilder`, with Onu controls (native selects, inputs, buttons, checkbox), translations and an RTL-aware layout.

## Overlays

Dialogs, sheets, popovers and menus.

- [Modal](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/overlays/modal.md): A dialog with a simple `title` / `description` / `footer` API, built on shadcn's `Dialog` (Radix).
- [ConfirmDialog](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/overlays/confirm-dialog.md): Asks the user to confirm an action, built on shadcn's `AlertDialog`.
- [SlideOver](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/overlays/slide-over.md): A panel that slides in from the side, for detail views, quick edits and filters.
- [BottomSheet](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/overlays/bottom-sheet.md): A pull-up panel anchored to the bottom of the screen.
- [PopoverPanel](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/overlays/popover-panel.md): A non-modal panel anchored to a trigger, for small forms, filters and extra details: Onu's simple-API popover.
- [Tip](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/overlays/tip.md): A tooltip that also works on touch screens.
- [ActionMenu](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/overlays/action-menu.md): A dropdown menu of actions built from an `items` array, on shadcn's `DropdownMenu` (Radix).
- [ContextActionMenu](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/overlays/context-action-menu.md): A context menu (right-click menu) built from the same `items` as `ActionMenu`, on shadcn's `ContextMenu` (Radix).
- [CommandPalette](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/overlays/command-palette.md): A ⌘K / Ctrl+K command palette for jumping to pages, records and commands from the keyboard.

## Loading

Spinners, skeletons and progress.

- [Spinner](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/loading/spinner.md): A spinning loading indicator with a screen-reader label.
- [Skeleton presets](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/loading/skeleton.md): Ready-made skeletons for the most common shapes: `SkeletonText`, `SkeletonCard` and `SkeletonTable`.
- [PlaceholderInput](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/loading/placeholder-input.md): A skeleton shaped like a form field (label, control and optional help text), for forms whose values are still loading.
- [LoadingOverlay](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/loading/loading-overlay.md): Covers a container (a card, table or form) while it loads or saves.
- [PageProgress](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/loading/page-progress.md): A thin bar at the top of the page that shows a navigation or long request is in progress, like NProgress.
- [ProgressBar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/loading/progress-bar.md): A determinate or indeterminate progress bar with an optional label and value text, in semantic colours.

## Layout and navigation

App layout, navigation and structure.

- [AppLayout](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/app-layout.md): The application shell: a Skip to content link, the sidebar, a header, the main content, an optional footer and an optional phone bottom navigation.
- [AppHeader](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/app-header.md): The top bar of an app or portal: an optional sidebar toggle, a logo, the main content (page title, breadcrumbs, navigation or search) and actions at the inline end.
- [TopNav](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/top-nav.md): Horizontal main navigation for headers, built on shadcn's `navigation-menu`.
- [MenuBar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/menu-bar.md): A desktop-style application menu bar (File, Edit, View …) described as data.
- [MegaMenu](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/mega-menu.md): Header navigation whose items open wide panels with several columns of links (each with an optional icon and description) and an optional featured area.
- [AppSidebar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/app-sidebar.md): The app's main sidebar with a simple `items` / `groups` API: icons, badges, nested items and the active state from the current URL.
- [AppSwitcher](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/app-switcher.md): The app switcher next to the logo, like Proton's grid button: a menu of the products in a suite, each on a brand-tinted tile.
- [SideNav](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/side-nav.md): A vertical navigation list that works on its own (settings pages, documentation, account pages) and inside drawers: groups, icons, badges, descriptions and collapsible nested items.
- [BottomNav](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/bottom-nav.md): Phone bottom navigation: three to five destinations with icons and short labels, badges and the active state.
- [SiteFooter](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/site-footer.md): The footer for portals and public pages: brand and description, link columns, social links, a copyright line, legal links and a slot for a `LanguageSwitcher`.
- [PageTitle](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/page-title.md): The page header of index, view and edit pages (§25.6, §25.8): the title, the main action button, and secondary links where a small dot marks e.g.
- [Breadcrumbs](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/breadcrumbs.md): A breadcrumb trail built on shadcn's `breadcrumb` (§25.8): every part is a link except the last, which is the current page.
- [Section](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/section.md): A page section with a heading, description and actions.
- [Card](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/card.md): shadcn's `Card`, extended. Without the new props it renders exactly like the shadcn card, so `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardAction`, `CardContent` and `CardFooter` still compose as before.
- [Tabs](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/tabs.md): shadcn's `Tabs` (Radix, WAI-ARIA tabs), extended with an `items` API, icons, counts and a tab list that scrolls sideways on phones.
- [NavTabs](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/nav-tabs.md): Link-based tabs for record pages (§25.8): "Profile", "Edit", "Activity (12)".
- [StackedTabs](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/stacked-tabs.md): Vertical tabs for settings-style pages: the tab list sits at the inline start with the panel beside it.
- [Accordion](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/accordion.md): shadcn's `Accordion` (Radix, WAI-ARIA accordion), extended with an `items` API and visual variants.
- [Wizard](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/wizard.md): A multi-step flow (application wizards, onboarding): a step list with each step's status, Back / Next buttons with per-step validation, jumping back to completed steps, a compact "Step 2 of 4" header with a progress b…
- [Timeline](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/timeline.md): A vertical timeline for status trackers and activity histories.
- [Divider](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/divider.md): A separator line built on shadcn's `Separator`, optionally with a label in the middle, at the start or at the end.
- [LanguageSwitcher](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/language-switcher.md): Switches between languages using their native names (English, ދިވެހި).
- [ThemeToggle](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/theme-toggle.md): Light / dark / system switch using `useTheme()` from `ThemeProvider` (R10.3).
- [NotificationCenter](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/notification-center.md): A bell button with the unread count that opens the notification list: a popover on desktop and a bottom sheet (vaul drawer) on phones.
- [UserProfile](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/user-profile.md): The signed-in user's avatar, name and role (or email), opening a menu with Profile, Settings, your own items and Sign out.
- [Logo](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/logo.md): The product or organisation logo with separate light and dark images, an optional wordmark, linking home.
- [UsageMeter](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/usage-meter.md): A quota meter for the bottom of the sidebar, like Proton's storage meter: a labelled bar with "used / total", an optional link (e.g.
- [SkipLink](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/skip-link.md): A "Skip to content" link (R14.4). Render it as the first focusable element on the page: it is visually hidden until it receives keyboard focus, then moves focus to the main content.
- [BackToTop](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/back-to-top.md): A floating "Back to top" button that appears after scrolling.
- [MasonryGrid](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/masonry-grid.md): A masonry layout with CSS columns (no JavaScript layout): items of different heights pack into columns.
- [OverlayMenu](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/overlay-menu.md): A full-screen overlay menu for portals, learning sites and kiosks.
- [Hero](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/hero.md): The opening block of a portal or content page (R3.7): a heading, lead text, calls to action, an optional search field, and either media beside the text or a photo behind it.
- [FeatureGrid](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/layout-and-navigation/feature-grid.md): A responsive grid of features or services (R3.7): each item has an icon, a title, a description and an optional link.

## Display and feedback

Badges, alerts, toasts and display components.

- [DescriptionList](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/description-list.md): Label–value pairs for record views ("Email: jane@example.com").
- [StatusBadge](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/status-badge.md): A status label that always pairs colour with an icon and text, so colour is never the only signal (R14.6).
- [Tag](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/tag.md): A compact label (chip) for categories, keywords and filters.
- [UserAvatar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/user-avatar.md): A person's picture with an initials fallback that handles English and Dhivehi names, sizes, shapes and a presence dot.
- [UserAvatarGroup](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/user-avatar-group.md): Overlapping avatars with a "+N" button that lists everyone else.
- [KeyboardKey](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/keyboard-key.md): Shows a key or keyboard shortcut using shadcn's `Kbd`.
- [Callout (Alert)](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/callout.md): An alert box for messages that need attention: info, success, warning or destructive, with a title, description, actions and an optional dismiss button.
- [Notice](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/notice.md): A subtle inline notice: a short line of supporting text with an icon, quieter than a Callout.
- [AnnouncementBar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/announcement-bar.md): A full-width bar at the top of the page for site-wide news.
- [CookieConsent](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/cookie-consent.md): A cookie banner with a preferences dialog.
- [Toast](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/toast.md): Short notifications, using sonner (shadcn's toast).
- [ConditionalLink](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/conditional-link.md): Renders a link only when there is somewhere to go and the user may go there; otherwise renders the same content as plain text.
- [ConditionalDisplay](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/conditional-display.md): Shows/hides or enables/disables part of a form depending on another field's value.
- [PublishBox](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/publish-box.md): The "Publish" panel of a content editor: status, visibility and publish date, with Preview, Save draft and Publish actions.
- [LastEditedBy](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/last-edited-by.md): "Last edited by Aishath Shiuna · 5 minutes ago", with a small avatar.
- [RelativeDate](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/relative-date.md): A date shown relative to now ("just now", "5 minutes ago", "3 days ago", "in 2 hours"), as specified in REQUIREMENTS §25.5.
- [Countdown](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/countdown.md): Counts down to a date in days, hours, minutes and seconds, with tabular numbers (R7.5).
- [ActivityFeed](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/activity-feed.md): A log of who did what and when: grouped by day (Today, Yesterday, 3 October 2026), with actor avatars, relative timestamps and a "Load more" button.
- [CommentThread](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/comment-thread.md): A discussion with nested replies. People can edit and delete their own comments, and the composer can type Thaana (`thaana` prop, R13.3).
- [Notes](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/notes.md): Internal notes on a record: who wrote what and when, with an add-note box that can type Thaana (`thaana` prop, R13.3) and delete with confirmation.
- [IconText](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/icon-text.md): An icon next to a short piece of text, aligned and sized together: meta rows such as location, date or phone number.
- [ShareButtons](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/share-buttons.md): Share a page. Where the device supports the Web Share API (most phones), one Share button opens the system share sheet.
- [PrintButton and BackButton](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/print-back-buttons.md): Two small helpers for detail pages, receipts and certificates.
- [MiniCalendar](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/mini-calendar.md): A compact, read-only month calendar with event dots, for portal sidebars and dashboards ("Upcoming events").
- [ContentCard](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/content-card.md): A card for news articles, services and events: image, title, excerpt, date, category, extra meta and a link.
- [Error pages](https://onu.on-forge.com/docs/display-and-feedback/error-page.md): Full-page error states with a code, title, message, illustration and actions (Go home, Go back, Try again), translated into English and Dhivehi.
